bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 6, 7, 10. PHANTOM MAJOR almost overcame traffic problems when he was produced within this distance range on debut at Newcastle. Expect him to make natural improvement today at only his second run in a race. QUEEN'S GAMBLE refused to shirk her task in defeat here first up over this journey with Tommy Berry aboard. She can only now present race-fitter. LAVA FLOW faces the starter for the first time. Rachel King has been aboard during two lead-up trials since a spell and she has the pace to make her own luck over this trip on debut.  ENDEAVOUR has trialed twice at his Rosehill home base since a spell and he is now also ready to make his debut.

raceTips.comment: Queens Gamble has been racing consistently and looks well placed to produce another strong performance. The gelding has shown a sharp turn of foot when finding clear running and there is an in form jockey aboard to add further confidence. Yoshida has been closing off nicely in recent outings and should appreciate a genuine tempo that allows the race to be run to suit. Phantom Major has continued to improve with racing and has the ability to settle close before giving a strong kick late. Maritime Magnate has been competitive against similar company and should enjoy the run of the race from a favourable draw. The consistent profile makes him a genuine contender throughout.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 6, 7. GLISSANDO was dominant from in front when she opened her account last start at Kembla Grange and she can be expected to cope with this step up from 1300m at only her third start in her first campaign. BLENHEIM GIRL looked the part here first up with Tommy Berry aboard and she will surprise nobody if she further progresses today in similar class. VIVA MAURICIO finished unplaced second up at Rosehill but there were excuses and he can make a mockery of that latest effort within the same distance range this afternoon. THREE ARROWS did all but win six days ago at Kembla Grange and a quick back-up can aid his cause when he now steps up into this distance range for the first time.

raceTips.comment: Glissando has continued to race well in similar company and looks to have found another suitable assignment. The filly has shown enough tactical speed to take up a handy position before finishing off strongly. Viva Mauricio has enough natural ability to measure up against this opposition and should be finishing off well if the speed is genuine. The race shape gives every chance to be competitive.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 6, 8, 11. HARRY'S EVIDENCE is resuming after winning a home based lead-up Rosehill trial. He scored with authority first up last campaign at Wyong and this race is also within his reach. SANDBI surprised the market place on debut on a heavy Gosford surface and he can play a part if he can replicate that effort in the prevailing conditions here. ROYAL AIR FORCE struck traffic problems when he was presented over this distance here last start. He kept trying in defeat on the day and he shouldn't be underestimated today when he attempts to overcome the widest gate. THE LITTLE GENERAL shouldn't be harshly judged for finishing unplaced here second up. He was a third up winner last campaign and history is capable of repeating here.

Sandbi brings the required last start form into the race and with improvement between runs will figure in the finish.

She's been given two lead-up trials and gear changes have been made. This race is within her reach! STUBBORN EMMELIE also begins her second campaign today. Tom Sherry was aboard for her lead-up trial at her Rosehill home base when she suggested that she should be treated with respect today. TIDES TURNING overcame problems to score at Grafton when she was produced over this distance last start and she's now ready to make her Canterbury debut.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10. SNACK BAR did a good job to finish as close to the winner as he did after he struck traffic problems at Rosehill. He will be making his Canterbury debut today and he can atone within the same distance range. CLEAR PROOF easily beat home all except the leader/winner here within this distance range third up and he still has scope to improve. RIMBAUD endured a tough run in transit at Warwick Farm but he refused to shirk his task in defeat. He should gain an easier run today. SILENCIO PORFAVOR and USEAPIN are others who are worthy of respect.

raceTips.comment: Snack Bar has developed a handy record and looks ready to produce another competitive performance. The gelding has shown versatility in his racing pattern and there is an in form jockey aboard to enhance his prospects. Clear Proof has been working home consistently in recent outings and should appreciate a race that allows him to build momentum. Rimbaud has been racing honestly and has enough class to be a major factor with the right run. bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 12. SISTER DAAE kept trying in defeat within this distance range at Warwick Farm in a race that's produced strong form. She can add to the strength of the subsequent form from that Warwick Farm race today. DORADUS was resuming at Wyong when he was responsible for a solid front-running effort and similar tactics can be adopted today. TWISTED QUEEN stepped up into this distance range on the Kensington track last Wednesday when her effort was more than acceptable. A quick back-up can now aid her cause. LET'S FLY was honest after she traveled without cover at Randwick. She was a winner here over this journey at her previous start and this race is also within her reach. TENDERIZE has been in work for some time but he performed well above market place expectations here within this distance range last start and with gear changes made, he can maintain his form today.

raceTips.comment: Conchiero has been racing with plenty of consistency and appears capable of producing another quality effort. The gelding has shown a strong finishing burst and can make his presence felt over the closing stages. Tenderize has continued to race honestly and should be suited by a race where the speed stays genuine throughout. Sister Daae has been improving with each appearance and has the talent to be highly competitive against this field. Let's Fly has produced several encouraging performances and should enjoy the opportunity to settle comfortably before working into the race. The consistent form profile gives plenty of confidence in another solid performance.
